heading: Battery Charger
bottomHtml:
A battery charger is a device that supplies electric energy to recharge a battery by forcing an electric current through it. Chargers are designed to restore the energy lost during a battery’s use, extending its lifespan and maintaining its efficiency.

Chargers vary widely based on the type of battery (lithium-ion, lead-acid, NiMH, etc.), size, and intended application — from small portable chargers for phones and laptops to larger ones for electric vehicles and industrial machinery. Some modern chargers feature smart technology that monitors battery health, prevents overcharging, and optimizes charging speed for better performance and safety.

Key features often include:

  • Automatic shut-off when fully charged

  • LED indicators or digital displays

  • Fast-charging capabilities

  • Protection against overheating and short-circuits

  • Compatibility with multiple battery types
